definition:
Sample actual A's C2 Hermite field after retaining its source background.

The baseline has h0'=w and h0''=wr from the unchanged metric source.
Only the nonround Cartesian perturbation is interpolated. Compare (i) old
full-height interpolation, (ii) preserving all old node means, and (iii)
subtracting the same RK12 background quadrature from each saved scalar mean
increment before adding the source primitive. These are numerical fields.

horizontal_rr.definition: W=Gamma Fr+((u_rr-Gamma u_r)/n_z)n, Gamma=w*w_r/E, with n from Fr and the actual cardinal Ftheta. Keep the supplied vertical rr jet.
horizontal_rr.scope: A shared target-metric second-jet completion for a new finite field; equality with the true ODE Cartesian rr is not asserted from sampled metric alone.

mean_correction.correction_definition: Use the separately accumulated engine perturbation mean supplied by the actual RK interior readout; the input total node mean already includes its source background primitive.
mean_correction.comparison_baseline: The total node means in this input complete.json, not necessarily the older accepted-A saved means.

limitations: Finite floating samples are not a continuous metric or curvature certificate.
Shared horizontal second jets use the explicitly recorded rule; target-metric completion is not a derivative-error certificate.
Correcting the separable background quadrature changes saved node means by the reported amount; no node change is hidden.
No new BVP, infinite tail, closed surface, reach, or large-amplitude conclusion.
